input.summary: The candidate fails on one checker rule, T-S2. The T2 Lantern platform at (-334,-575) is not on straight track. The r100 fillet at (-334,-600) at the end of the Sunset Way shift runs on past z -590, so it reaches into the platform. Vantage marked Datum's hand-off done: true and said every stop is on straight track. The checker shows that claim is false. Every other rule passes. Last round's faults are fixed: N-R1 now passes (worst area 247 m), the fare note has been removed (boarding is priced in time only), and Datum's hand-off has been answered. These are open questions, not faults: (a) the plan text puts S1 Crown Circus at 95 and Harbour at 340, but the candidate uses 90 and 290 (Pulse has handed this to Datum); (b) no standard covers the flat crossing of T1 and T2 at (0,-726), or how their headways fit together there; (c) notes/why still describes the old draft, which Aster needs to settle.

faults.fault: The T2 Lantern stop at (-334,-575) puts its 30 m platform (z -590 to -560) partly on the curve. The r100 fillet at (-334,-600) at the end of the Sunset Way shift runs on past z -590, so the curve ends later than Vantage's note says. The checker reports 6 of 7 T2 platforms on straight track. Vantage's answer to Datum's hand-off says done: true and 'all on straight track', which the checker shows is false.
faults.fix: Move Lantern north until the whole platform is past the fillet tangent (about z -550 or further north). Keep the gap to Rocket at 300 m or more: move Rocket north by the same amount (e.g. -265 to -245). Rocket-west then stays within about 90 m. The other option is to ask Datum to shorten or move the Sunset shift. Then rerun the plan checker.
